mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market fuels consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adapt to new efficiencies.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth above 5% in a month indicates increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth rate is below 2%, the combination of moderate monetary policy and low inflation supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.012 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two months signals a potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% in a quarter, combined with housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicates robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 30% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.
